notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it, regenerating target artifact.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Welding Jar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast Welding Jar from the top of your library by paying 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
